sites.name: Megalithic Jar Sites in Xiengkhuang
sites.what: Iron Age funerary sites across Xiengkhuang include large carved stone jars, quarries and burials. UNESCO’s serial property includes 15 components.

access.closures: Not yet checked. Smartraveller reports unexploded remnants of war near the Plain of Jars and advises staying on established paths and roads.
